subject: Galen Health — SOC 2 architecture & evidence walk-through (scheduling)
body:
From: Camila Reyes <camila@redwood.com>
To: Sam Patel <sam.patel@galenhealth.com>, DevOps Team <devops@galenhealth.com>
Cc: Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwood.com>, Mina Haddad <mina_haddad@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 2 May 2027 16:14:00 -0400
Subject: Galen Health — SOC 2 architecture & evidence walk-through (scheduling)

Hi Sam / Galen team,

Thanks again for the interest in a technical deep-dive. Per our kick-off, the next step is a focused session to walk your security and compliance folks through our architecture and the SOC 2 evidence mapping (encryption, audit logs, SSO). Goal: align on which artifacts you need and confirm timelines for evidence handoff.

Proposed agenda (30–45 min):
- High-level serving & data flow (redwood components that touch customer data)
- Encryption at rest/in transit & KMS integrations
- Audit logs: retention, structure, and where we surface them
- SSO / SCIM / RBAC options and verification steps
- SOC 2 evidence checklist and next steps / owners

Available slots this week:
- Wed May 4, 10:00–10:45 AM ET
- Wed May 4, 3:00–3:45 PM ET
- Thu May 5, 11:30–12:15 PM ET

If none of those work, tell us two windows that fit your security team and well accommodate. Im cc'ing Aditya (sales lead) and Mina from our security team so we can cover both procurement and technical evidence questions.

Attachments: SOC2_evidence_checklist.xlsx (starter checklist), redwood_serving_arch_diagram.png

Thanks,
Camila Reyes
Senior Solutions Engineer, Redwood Inference
camila@redwood.com | +1 (415) 555-0192

---
From: Sam Patel <sam.patel@galenhealth.com>
To: Camila Reyes <camila@redwood.com>
Cc: DevOps Team <devops@galenhealth.com>, Priya Nair <priya.nair@galenhealth.com>
Date: Tue, 3 May 2027 09:07:00 -0400
Subject: Re: Galen Health — SOC 2 architecture & evidence walk-through (scheduling)

Thanks Camila — Wed May 4 at 3:00 PM ET works for our security lead (Priya) and two folks from DevOps. Quick note: Priya asked whether you can also show the audit-log schema (fields and examples) and whether we can get a short list of the log retention policies to share with our auditors before the call.

Also, can you confirm if the walk-through will include our preferred KMS (GCP KMS) integration steps or if that's follow-up?

—Sam
Sam Patel
Head of IT Security, Galen Health
sam.patel@galenhealth.com | +1 (617) 555-8421

---
From: Mina Haddad <mina_haddad@redwood.com>
To: Sam Patel <sam.patel@galenhealth.com>
Cc: Camila Reyes <camila@redwood.com>, Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 3 May 2027 09:38:00 -0400
Subject: Re: Galen Health — SOC 2 architecture & evidence walk-through (scheduling)

Hi Sam — great, we will include a short example audit-log export (sanitized) and a one-page summary of retention defaults + options. Regarding KMS: well cover our supported KMS integrations at a high level during the call and walk through the end-to-end flow for GCP KMS if you want deep implementation guidance; we can schedule a follow-up with our infra team for an implementation workshop if needed.

For the audit logs, please let us know if you need CSV or JSON examples.

Mina Haddad
Lead Security Engineer, Redwood Inference
mina_haddad@redwood.com

From: Camila Reyes <camila@redwood.com>
To: Sam Patel <sam.patel@galenhealth.com>, DevOps Team <devops@galenhealth.com>
Cc: Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwood.com>, Mina Haddad <mina_haddad@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 3 May 2027 12:02:00 -0400
Subject: Re: Galen Health — SOC 2 architecture & evidence walk-through (scheduling)

Perfect — Ive booked Wed May 4, 3:00–3:45 PM ET and sent a calendar invite with a short pre-read (link below).

Pre-read / links: 
- Evidence checklist: https://docs.google.com/document/d/1gX8-evidence-plan
- Invite: https://calendar.google.com/event?eid=redwood-galen-arch-0504
- Example audit-log export (sanitized) will be attached to the invite as a stub: audit_logs_example.json

If you want CSV instead of JSON for the logs, tell me now and well swap it. Otherwise, look for the invite — Aditya will include commercial contacts and next-step items after the call.

See you then,
Camila
